items.title: Will the Democratic sweep cloud crypto market structure?
items.summary:
Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress, putting the CLARITY Act’s path in doubt after it stalled in the Senate in September. Analysts expect tougher consumer protections and stablecoin yield limits in the next draft. Plus, Bitcoin ETFs see $430 in outflows and Canary Capital launches an INJ ETF. CoinDesk’s Jennifer Sanasie hosts “CoinDesk Daily.”

items.title: Bitcoin gains undone by massive tech sell-off, triggering liquidations
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses how bitcoin's (BTC-USD) latest rebound above $80,000 per token this week was swiftly erased following the massive tech sell-off that rocked Wall Street on Thursday.
